enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket down. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Pick up pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Pick up bread. Eat bread. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Lay clothes on bed. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Button shirt. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on uniform. Check schedule. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Record notes. Walk to nurse station. Use computer to update records. Answer phone. Consult with doctor. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Assist patient with mobility. Remove gloves. Wash hands again. Attend team meeting. Break for lunch. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue patient care. Clock out.
Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food. Walk to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Eat. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV, avoiding high-energy appliance use during peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Drink. Put down drink. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry (washing and drying clothes) after peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Load clothes. Add detergent. Close washing machine. Press start button. Wait. Open dryer. Load clothes from washer. Close dryer. Press start button. Wait. Open dryer. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Put clothes away. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer or watching TV for leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Open browser. Browse internet. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Watch video. Close laptop. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channels. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom.
Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still.
